Copy Dec. 6th 1842.
Prof. James C. Fisher
Assistant Superintendent of Telegraphs
Sir,
On the receipt of this I wish you to inform
me how much Pipe M. Salthan have completed, and
if 30 miles have been completed, or even twenty five miles if so, let them
stop making any more from being
made, and if no more have been made be sure
that further orders according to Mr. Smith's request
be sent to Washington -- have faithfully tried
to inform you also if you have finished the wires with the
Battling in each coil before they were soldered up
and packed, and if all is perfect insulation. -- We are about to commence on Salthan's pipe.
Respectfully
Sam. P. B. Morse
Interdent of Telegraphs
Geo. P. Smith
99271 West Capitol St. O. C.
30. J. Smith
